title: Harden Codex URL extraction and bounded research partial failures
description: Fix provider-generated URL delimiter pollution; make independent research query failures diagnosable and continue only for nonfatal malformed/no-source responses; avoid duplicate output-bound warnings with focused tests.

logs.msg: Implemented Codex answer URL delimiter trimming; web_research now continues independent malformed-response queries with partial status; deduplicated output-bound warnings and detects result truncation. Added focused tests and updated failure-policy docs. bun run check passes (218 tests).
